body:
WHAT
Sessions are the saved conversations of a workspace, one JSONL file each under `.magentra/sessions/`. The engine lists them with a human-readable label — the first real user message (harness reminders stripped) or a user-given name — plus timestamps and the last model. Sessions can be renamed (a `meta` record is appended), archived (moved to `sessions/archive/`) and deleted (file plus its task file removed), and each change re-emits `session_list`.

WHY
Without labels a user can only tell sessions apart by timestamp, and without rename/archive/delete the list grows forever with no way to tidy it.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/engine.ts — `listSessions()`, `renameSession()`, `archiveSession()`, `deleteSession()`, request handlers for `list_sessions`, `rename_session`, `archive_session`, `delete_session`, `handleSlash` case 'sessions'; engine/core/src/state/transcript.ts — `Transcript.firstUserText()` (reads only the first 64 KB), `Transcript.latestMeta()` (reads only the last 64 KB), `stripSystemReminders()`, `Transcript` constructor (`sessions/` vs `sessions/subagents/`). Protocol type engine/protocol/src/types.ts `SessionSummary`.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Write a transcript whose first user message is '<system-reminder>ctx</system-reminder>What is 2+2?'; list_sessions returns a summary with firstUserMessage 'What is 2+2?' and no reminder text.
2. rename_session {id, label:'My work'} appends a meta record that still carries the previous stats/model, and the following session_list shows label 'My work'; an empty label yields an error frame and no change.
3. archive_session moves sessions/<id>.jsonl to sessions/archive/<id>.jsonl and the id disappears from the next session_list; archiving the active session is refused with a command_output notice.
4. delete_session removes sessions/<id>.jsonl and tasks/<id>.json and emits session_list without the id; deleting the active session is refused.
5. A subagent transcript written under sessions/subagents/ never appears in list_sessions, and a corrupt first line does not make firstUserText throw (it returns undefined and the listing still succeeds).
